critical_code_review_comments: Banking validation API contract: payout-readiness returns 'not_a_contractor' blocked_reason for admin self-call — this is the correct signal and prevents the alert from showing on admin's own dashboard. Frontend ContractorDashboard correctly gates the banking-validation-alert behind accrued_total > 0 AND ready=false.
Permissions whitelist properly enforced server-side: PATCH with ['add_users','manage_subscriptions','bogus_perm','view_referral_emails'] persists only the 3 valid perms — bogus_perm dropped silently.

Leaderboard endpoint returns ranked rows with composite metrics (earnings, call_volume, referred_count, conversion_rate, stripe_ready). 'stripe_ready: false' for both seeded contractors visually surfaces 'Manquant' badge on Stripe column.

POST /contractor/clients permission gating logic correct (verified at line 1338 of twilio.py): for a real contractor (role=dialer_contractor) lacking 'add_users', returns 403 with message_en mentioning 'add_users'. Buyer hits earlier role-check and gets generic 'contractor only' 403 — both are acceptable per spec.
Admin override on payout-readiness (?contractor_id=X) works for admin but rejected with 403 for non-admin trying to view someone else's readiness — proper authorization.
Bilingual labels render cleanly in FR (Classement des contractants / Permissions accordées). Backend message_fr is present on duplicate-email error and other 4xx responses.

rca of the issue: No bug found. One investigation note: testbuyer's POST /contractor/clients returns {'detail':'contractor only'} (without message_en/message_fr envelope) because the role-check fires before the permission-check — this is fine since a buyer cannot legally call this endpoint at all. For a real contractor missing add_users, the route at line 1338 of twilio.py correctly returns the bilingual error envelope mentioning 'add_users' (verified in source). The pytest test_buyer_cannot_create_referred_client correctly asserts only 403.
